description: This file contains utility functions for handling safe directory and path operations, package name parsing, and path validation within a project, specifically related to installation paths and directory safety.

methods.name: unscopedPackageName
methods.description: Extracts the unscoped package name from a given string, trimming whitespace and handling scoped package names.

methods.name: packageNameMatchesId
methods.description: Checks if a package name matches a given identifier, considering scoped and unscoped names.

methods.name: safeDirName
methods.description: Sanitizes a directory name by replacing slashes and backslashes with underscores.

methods.name: safePathSegmentHashed
methods.description: Creates a safe, hashed path segment from an input string, replacing unsafe characters and appending a hash.

methods.name: resolveSafeInstallDir
methods.description: Resolves and validates a safe installation directory path based on provided parameters.

methods.name: assertCanonicalPathWithinBase
methods.description: Asynchronously verifies that a candidate path stays within a specified base directory, ensuring it is a real directory and not a symlink.
